units.source_text: 黑正面临着要消掉从右下方直占到中央的白大模样的攻防战，酣战中哪能抽手到别的地方去呢。

en.t: Black was now facing a battle to erase White's large framework stretching from the lower right straight into the center, and in the midst of such a fierce fight, how could he possibly spare a move elsewhere?

units.source_text: 八幡干事一直在从中央到右下的战场上搜索，这是理所当然的。

en.t: It was only natural that Secretary Yahata had been searching all along for moves on the battlefield from the center to the lower right.
